name: divinediscourses-exports
description: Computed tables from the Divine Discourses Qur'an study platform: root frequencies, root-pair association statistics, per-surah statistics, and verse lengths, derived from the Leeds Quranic Arabic Corpus v0.4.
citeAs: Divine Discourses project. Divine Discourses, version 1.2.0. 2026. https://divinediscourses.org.

recordSet.name: association-pairs
recordSet.description: Root-pair association statistics: the union of every pair appearing in any root's top-25-by-LLR partner list, deduplicated by unordered pair.

field.name: rootA
field.description: First root of the pair (Buckwalter).

field.name: rootASafeKey
field.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of rootA.

field.name: rootALatin
field.description: rootA in Latin transliteration.

field.name: rootB
field.description: Second root of the pair (Buckwalter).

field.name: rootBSafeKey
field.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of rootB.

field.name: rootBLatin
field.description: rootB in Latin transliteration.

field.name: sharedVerses
field.description: k11: number of verses in which both roots are attested.

field.name: pmi
field.description: Pointwise mutual information: log2((k11*N)/((k11+k12)*(k11+k21))), N=6,236, rounded to 2 decimals.

field.name: dice
field.description: Dice coefficient: 2*k11/(2*k11+k12+k21), rounded to 3 decimals.

field.name: llr
field.description: Dunning's log-likelihood ratio (G2) over the pair's verse-level 2x2 table, rounded to 2 decimals.

recordSet.name: centrality
recordSet.description: Network centrality for all 1,642 roots over the root co-occurrence graph (5,211 edges, built from each root's top-25-by-LLR partners).

field.name: root
field.description: Buckwalter-transliterated root.

field.name: safeKey
field.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of root.

field.name: rootLatin
field.description: Root in Latin transliteration with diacritics.

field.name: degree
field.description: Count of distinct partner roots.

field.name: degreeRank
field.description: Rank by degree, 1 = highest, among 1,642 roots.

field.name: weightedDegree
field.description: Sum of incident edge weights (LLR).

field.name: weightedDegreeRank
field.description: Rank by weighted degree.

field.name: betweenness
field.description: Betweenness centrality (unweighted shortest paths).

field.name: betweennessRank
field.description: Rank by betweenness.

field.name: eigenvector
field.description: Eigenvector centrality (LLR-weighted, power iteration, L2-normalized).

field.name: eigenvectorRank
field.description: Rank by eigenvector centrality.

recordSet.name: discursive-pivots
recordSet.description: 137 verses mechanically flagged for opening with a temporal particle (idh or idha) while sharing a content root with the immediately preceding verse.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number.

field.name: verse
field.description: The flagged verse.

field.name: marker
field.description: The temporal particle opening the verse: idh or idha.

field.name: previousVerse
field.description: The preceding verse the flagged verse shares a root with.

field.name: sharedRoots
field.description: Semicolon-separated list of the shared root(s) in Latin transliteration.

recordSet.name: dispersion
recordSet.description: How evenly each of the 1,642 roots is spread across the 114 surahs, weighted by surah token count.

field.name: root
field.description: Buckwalter-transliterated root.

field.name: safeKey
field.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of root.

field.name: rootLatin
field.description: Root in Latin transliteration with diacritics.

field.name: totalCount
field.description: Corpus-wide occurrence count.

field.name: surahsOccurringIn
field.description: Count of the 114 surahs the root occurs in at least once.

field.name: dp
field.description: Gries's Deviation of Proportions. Range [0, 1 - min part share]. Attains 1 - min part share exactly when all occurrences fall in the corpus's smallest part.

field.name: dpNorm
field.description: DP rescaled to [0, 1] via the Lijffijt & Gries (2012) correction. Attains 1 at the same extreme as dp's own maximum.

field.name: juillandD
field.description: Juilland's D; 1 = perfectly even. Not clamped, can be negative.

field.name: adjustedFrequency
field.description: totalCount * (1 - dp): raw frequency discounted for clumping.

recordSet.name: fawatih
recordSet.description: The 29 surahs opening with a sequence of isolated letters (fawatih / al-muqatta'at), and which combination.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number.

field.name: verse
field.description: Verse carrying the isolated letters (always 1).

field.name: letters
field.description: The isolated letters in Arabic script, as written.

recordSet.name: formulaic-density
recordSet.description: Per-surah mean share of words covered by a recurring 3-5-word phrase (Bannister's oral-formulaic density), tested against a length-matched null, for all 114 surahs.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number.

field.name: verseCount
field.description: Verses in this surah.

field.name: meanDensityRoot
field.description: Mean per-verse root-stream formulaic density, 0-1.

field.name: pValueRoot
field.description: One-sided permutation p-value, root stream.

field.name: survivorRoot
field.description: Survives the pooled BH-FDR correction at q<0.05, root stream.

field.name: meanDensitySurface
field.description: Mean per-verse surface-stream formulaic density, 0-1.

field.name: pValueSurface
field.description: One-sided permutation p-value, surface stream.

field.name: survivorSurface
field.description: Survives the pooled BH-FDR correction at q<0.05, surface stream.

recordSet.name: formulas
recordSet.description: Every recurring 3-5 word sequence in the Qur'an (18,408 rows: 6,403 root-view + 12,005 surface-view), with its first occurrence.

field.name: stream
field.description: root or surface.

field.name: n
field.description: Sequence length, 3-5.

field.name: display
field.description: Root stream: dot-separated Latin transliteration. Surface stream: the Arabic phrase itself.

field.name: arabic
field.description: Arabic script for the sequence (root stream: root letters; surface stream: same as display).

field.name: count
field.description: Total occurrences of this sequence across the corpus.

field.name: firstSurah
field.description: Surah of the sequence's first occurrence.

field.name: firstVerse
field.description: Verse of the sequence's first occurrence.

recordSet.name: rhyme-summary
recordSet.description: Per-surah roll-up of verse-ending (rhyme) patterns for all 114 surahs.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number, 1-114.

field.name: verseCount
field.description: Number of verses in the surah.

field.name: familyCount
field.description: Count of distinct fine-key rhyme families in the surah.

field.name: dominantKey
field.description: The most frequent fine rhyme key in the surah.

field.name: dominantShare
field.description: Share of verses ending on the dominant key, 0-1.

field.name: shiftCount
field.description: Number of verse-to-verse changes in the fine rhyme key.

field.name: topRefrainPausal
field.description: Pausal form of the most-repeated verse ending recurring 3+ times, if any; null otherwise.

field.name: topRefrainCount
field.description: Occurrences of topRefrainPausal; null if there is no refrain.

field.name: meanRunLength
field.description: verseCount / (shiftCount + 1): average consecutive-verse run on one ending before it changes.

recordSet.name: root-frequencies
recordSet.description: Every one of the 1,642 roots: raw occurrence count, overall normalized frequency, and per-period count and normalized frequency.

field.name: root
field.description: Buckwalter-transliterated root.

field.name: safeKey
field.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of root, used to link to data/association/{safeKey}.json and roots.html?root={safeKey}.

field.name: arabic
field.description: Root letters in Arabic script, space-separated.

field.name: rootLatin
field.description: Root in Latin transliteration with diacritics.

field.name: totalCount
field.description: Total occurrences of this root across the whole corpus (77,429 tokens).

field.name: normalizedFrequencyOverall
field.description: (totalCount / 77,429) * 1000.

field.name: count_meccan-early
field.description: Occurrences of this root in the Early Meccan period.

field.name: normalizedFrequency_meccan-early
field.description: (count_meccan-early / period token total) * 1000.

field.name: count_meccan-middle
field.description: Occurrences of this root in the Middle Meccan period.

field.name: normalizedFrequency_meccan-middle
field.description: (count_meccan-middle / period token total) * 1000.

field.name: count_meccan-late
field.description: Occurrences of this root in the Late Meccan period.

field.name: normalizedFrequency_meccan-late
field.description: (count_meccan-late / period token total) * 1000.

field.name: count_medinan
field.description: Occurrences of this root in the Medinan period.

field.name: normalizedFrequency_medinan
field.description: (count_medinan / period token total) * 1000.

recordSet.name: structure
recordSet.description: Mechanically segmented sections for all 114 surahs (TextTiling-derived changepoint detection over lexical cohesion), not a transcribed scholarly outline.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number.

field.name: sectionIndex
field.description: 1-based section number within the surah.

field.name: fromVerse
field.description: First verse of the section.

field.name: toVerse
field.description: Last verse of the section.

field.name: verseCount
field.description: Number of verses in the section.

recordSet.name: structure-tests
recordSet.description: Four block-level mirror-symmetry tests (concentric pairing, inclusio, formula bookending, verse-length symmetry) over the computed sections in the structure table, one row per surah.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number.

field.name: verseCount
field.description: Verses in the surah.

field.name: sections
field.description: Number of computed sections (from the structure table).

field.name: concentricParallelism_observed
field.description: Observed mean Jaccard similarity of mirrored section pairs; null if the surah has too few sections for this test.

field.name: concentricParallelism_pValue
field.description: Permutation p-value for concentricParallelism; null if not applicable.

field.name: concentricParallelism_survivor
field.description: Whether this candidate survived the pooled Benjamini-Hochberg correction; null if not applicable.

field.name: inclusio_observed
field.description: Observed vocabulary overlap between the first and last section; null if not applicable.

field.name: inclusio_pValue
field.description: Permutation p-value for inclusio; null if not applicable.

field.name: inclusio_survivor
field.description: Whether this candidate survived correction; null if not applicable.

field.name: formulaBookending_observed
field.description: Observed formula-bracketing statistic; null if not applicable.

field.name: formulaBookending_pValue
field.description: Permutation p-value for formulaBookending; null if not applicable.

field.name: formulaBookending_survivor
field.description: Whether this candidate survived correction; null if not applicable.

field.name: lengthSymmetry_observed
field.description: Observed correlation of the verse-length profile with its reverse; null if not applicable.

field.name: lengthSymmetry_pValue
field.description: Permutation p-value for lengthSymmetry; null if not applicable.

field.name: lengthSymmetry_survivor
field.description: Whether this candidate survived correction; null if not applicable.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number, 1-114, Cairo (mushaf) order.

field.name: nameTranslit
field.description: Transliterated surah name.

field.name: nameArabic
field.description: Surah name in Arabic script.

field.name: nameEnglish
field.description: English meaning of the surah name.

field.name: revelationOrder
field.description: Position in the Cairo 1924 revelation-order sequence (1 = first revealed).

field.name: period
field.description: One of meccan-early, meccan-middle, meccan-late, medinan (Nöldeke-Bell four-period classification).

field.name: verseCount
field.description: Number of verses (ayat) in the surah, Cairo numbering.

field.name: tokenCount
field.description: Total Leeds morphological tokens in the surah.

field.name: distinctRootCount
field.description: Count of distinct roots attested in the surah.

field.name: rootDiversityRatio
field.description: distinctRootCount / tokenCount.

field.name: distinctFormCount
field.description: Count of distinct surface (written) forms in the surah.

field.name: formDiversityRatio
field.description: distinctFormCount / tokenCount. Mechanically declines as tokenCount grows (a sample-size artifact); see formMATTR/formMTLD for length-robust alternatives.

field.name: formMATTR
field.description: Moving-average type-token ratio (Covington & McFall 2010) over the surah's ordered surface-form tokens, 25-token window. Null for the 9 surahs shorter than the window.

field.name: formMTLD
field.description: Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity (McCarthy & Jarvis 2010): mean tokens-per-factor at a 0.72 TTR threshold, bidirectionally averaged. Null only if the surah's running TTR never reaches the threshold.

field.name: distinctLemmaCount
field.description: Count of distinct lemmas in the surah.

field.name: lemmaDiversityRatio
field.description: distinctLemmaCount / tokenCount.

field.name: nounPct
field.description: Percentage of the surah's tokens tagged noun (N) by Leeds POS tagging.

field.name: verbPct
field.description: Percentage of the surah's tokens tagged verb (V) by Leeds POS tagging.

recordSet.name: theme-surah-density
recordSet.description: Sparse theme-by-surah matrix: for each surah, the themes whose root-family vocabulary clusters most densely in it.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number.

field.name: themeSlug
field.description: Theme identifier, matches themes.html's slug.

field.name: themeTitle
field.description: Theme display title.

field.name: perThousand
field.description: Density of this theme's root family in this surah.

recordSet.name: verse-lengths
recordSet.description: Every verse in the corpus (6,236 rows) with its token length and revelation period.

field.name: surah
field.description: Surah number, 1-114.

field.name: verse
field.description: Verse (ayah) number within the surah, Cairo numbering.

field.name: tokens
field.description: Number of Leeds morphological tokens in this verse.

field.name: period
field.description: One of meccan-early, meccan-middle, meccan-late, medinan; null if the surah has no chronology entry.
